question: The inaugural season of the Hockey India League took place in 2013. Which city hosted the final match?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ranchi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The inaugural season of the Hockey India League (HIL) was held in 2013, a professional field hockey league in India aimed at promoting the sport.
 
• The final match of the tournament took place in Ranchi, the capital of Jharkhand, which is known for its enthusiasm for hockey.
 
• Ranchi Rhinos, the home team, emerged victorious in the final match of the 2013 HIL, defeating Delhi Waveriders by 2-1.
 
• The tournament featured five franchises: Delhi Waveriders, Ranchi Rhinos, Uttar Pradesh Wizards, Punjab Warriors, and Mumbai Magicians.
 
• The Hockey India League was launched by Hockey India in partnership with the International Hockey Federation (FIH) to boost the popularity of hockey in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delhi:**
 
 
• Delhi, the capital of India, had a franchise in the league named Delhi Waveriders.
 
• Delhi Waveriders were one of the strongest teams in the inaugural season and reached the final match but lost to Ranchi Rhinos.
 
• The city frequently hosts national and international hockey events due to its world-class facilities like the Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium.
 
 
 
• **Lucknow:**
 
 
• Lucknow, the capital city of Uttar Pradesh, was represented by the Uttar Pradesh Wizards in the Hockey India League.
 
• The city is home to the Dhyan Chand Astroturf Stadium, which has hosted several HIL matches.
 
• Despite its strong hockey culture, Lucknow did not host the final match in the inaugural season.
 
 
 
• **Mohali:**
 
 
• Mohali, a city in Punjab, was represented by the Punjab Warriors franchise in the Hockey India League.
 
• The Punjab Warriors played their home matches at the International Hockey Stadium in Mohali.
 
• While Mohali has a vibrant hockey tradition, it was not the venue for the final match of the 2013 HIL.
 
 
 
• **Hockey India League:**
 
 
• The HIL was launched in 2013 to revitalize interest in hockey, which is considered India's national sport.
 
• The league followed a franchise-based model, similar to cricket's Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
• It attracted several international players, enhancing the competitiveness and visibility of Indian hockey.
